extDescription.message: Checks "Also send to channel" when you reply in a Slack thread, and picks the current channel when you forward a message.

optAutoBroadcast.message: Also send thread replies to the channel

optAutoBroadcastHint.message: Checks the box for you. Uncheck it to keep one reply in the thread only.

optForwardCurrentHint.message: Picks the channel you're in when you forward a message. You can remove it.

popupNote.message: Changes apply right away. Works in Slack in your browser. Just installed? Reload any Slack tab that was already open.
